text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My skin feels a teeny bitworse than usual, maybe~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Any ideas...? The only thing that comes to mind
is what happened last night—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El told me, "It's definitely delicious, desu!"
and I ended up trying the super spicy sauce...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That was incredibly spicy...
*sigh* I really must be more careful with unfamiliar things...
